versions.localizedDescription:
Build: feat: integracao Pluggy Open Finance (aba Banco, Edge Functions, adapter)

Aba "Banco" que conecta contas via Pluggy Connect (widget WKWebView) e
importa transacoes para a tabela `transaction` do app.

Backend (supabase/):
- Edge Function pluggy-webhook: recebe eventos, responde 2XX rapido e
  sincroniza item/contas/transacoes via API da Pluggy (GET /v2/transactions
  com paginacao por cursor). Tabelas pluggy_* com RLS; grants explicitos
  para service_role; policies de SELECT para authenticated + is_approved().
- Edge Function pluggy-connect-token: troca clientId/clientSecret ->
  connectToken no servidor (verify_jwt + is_approved()). As credenciais da
  Pluggy e o segredo do webhook ficam so em `supabase secrets` — nada de
  PLUGGY_* vai no app (Info.plist / Environment / xcconfig limpos).
- security_check.sql: audita RLS/grants/is_approved() (read-only).

App:
- BankConnectViewModel chama functions.invoke("pluggy-connect-token").
- Adapter Pluggy -> Domain (FinancialApp/Services/Pluggy/Adapter/):
  PluggyTransaction (DTO), PluggyTransactionMapper (description->title,
  amount->value com sinal cru, date tz-aware, categoria "Open Finance"
  resolvida por titulo, id = transactionId para idempotencia),
  PluggySyncService (le pluggy_transaction, pula ja importadas, insere).
- Import disparado no onItemCreated e no pull-to-refresh da lista.
- FinancialAppCLI: alvo de teste local que mantem o PluggyClient nativo
  (removido do target do app).
